query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('photos',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)),'[]') FROM (SELECT p.id,p.short_id,p.title,count(*) AS likes,jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('user',u.username,'link',l.share_link_id,'at',l.created_at)) AS likers FROM likes l JOIN photos p ON p.id=l.photo_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id=l.user_id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 200) x),'users',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)),'[]') FROM (SELECT u.username,count(*) AS likes FROM likes l JOIN users u ON u.id=l.user_id GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY count(*) DESC) x)) AS "page!"
